messages:
tara: Quick heads-up — PR #482 (docs/release-brief) is ready for review. Needs short what's-new bullets + known-issues note for embed streaming fallback. Can someone check SDK snippets and the Go example? /cc @miguel @sophia

miguel: on it. I'll sanity-check the Go snippet and the curl examples. Any link migrations to watch for?

sophia: FYI there's a migration redirect we disabled last week — see https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/embed to update links. Also known issue: dedicated clusters may return 503 during canary resizes, we should call that out.

tara: good catch. Draft bullets: 1) Embed streaming deprecation timeline, 2) New routing policy flags, 3) Known 503 during dedicated canary. Thoughts?

kevin: add note about SDK: python client v0.9 changes param name from model->model_name. I made a quick snippet, please use it: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model_name="redwood-kestrel-1", prompt="hi")
print(resp)
```

sophia: that change needs a migration blurb and a link to the SDK changelog. Also, the curl sample needs Content-Type header fix: `-H "Content-Type: application/json"`.

docsbot: Reminder: docs PR #482 has merge conflicts with main. Run `make docs-build` locally and resolve the anchors.

miguel: I pushed a tiny fix to the Go snippet & updated the curl header. Also removed an outdated anchor.

tara: Can someone do a final pass on the 'known issues' copy? Keep it short (2-3 lines each). I'll assemble final what's-new and ping product for approval by EOD.

sophia: I'll do it. Quick draft: "Users on Dedicated may observe transient 503s during canary resizes; retry with backoff. Embed streaming will be deprecated on June 30th — see migration guide. SDK parameter rename: model -> model_name; update pinned snippets." Please tweak tone.

kevin: LGTM. I'll approve the PR after docsbot clears the build.

tara: thanks — assigning final check to @tara. If approved, I'll land and cut the docs patch release.
